verification_instructions: Run 'flutter analyze' to check for lint errors. Run 'flutter test' to run all unit and widget tests. Run 'flutter build apk --release' to build the Android APK if all tests pass. On Windows, use flutter doctor to verify Android SDK setup.
environment_constraints: Windows development machine. Android SDK required for build verification. No backend or IoT integration.
contribution_requirements: All code must follow Dart/Flutter conventions. Use provider for state management. Keep calculation logic separate from UI. All models must be immutable (final fields). Use const constructors where possible. Follow Material Design 3 guidelines.
key_patterns: Flutter boilerplate uses stateful widgets. Material App with theme configuration. Themes use ColorScheme.fromSeed. Standard MaterialApp with routes for navigation. Use pubspec.yaml for dependency management.
directory_structure: lib/ - main application code (to be structured into models/, services/, screens/, widgets/); test/ - unit and widget tests; android/ - Android build configuration; ios/ - iOS build configuration; .agents/tasks/ - planning and review artifacts
